Dialogs.Dialog: Where's this coming from？ That's not true.
(Hmm, she's really in a bad mood today. I guess I have been cold lately...)
I'm really sorry, I won't do it again！
Don't worry about it so much！
No, I don't want to forgive you.
Why are you so... I'll apologize properly.
If you don't understand, then forget it...
If I made you feel bad, I'm sorry.
Yes, it's fine. I'm a little strange today, huh.
(She forgave me. I'll be more careful.)
Hey, you've been... cold lately, haven't you？
Do you... not like me anymore？
(Hmm, is she really hurt？ I guess I have been cold lately...)
I'm really sorry, I won't do it again！
Don't worry about it so much！
I don't think I can take it anymore...
Yes, I've been a little off lately.
(She forgave me. I'll be more careful.)
No... I'm not imagining it. Because...
Because... I don't know what to do...
(She seems serious... I guess I have been cold lately...)
I'm really sorry, I won't do it again！
Don't worry about it so much！
There's no way I can cheer up.
Haha, don't be so mad. Come on, smile, smile.
As if I could cheer up that fast...
...Geez. Yes, maybe I got a little too mad too.
(She forgave me. I'll be more careful.)
Before that, I think there's something you should say.
(She might still be mad, so never mind...)
(She might still be mad, so never mind...)
(She might still be mad, so never mind...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Hey, let's go on a date.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Hey, let's go on a date.
A date... No. I don't want to go.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Hey, let's go on a date.
A date？ ...You still haven't apologized properly.
(A call... Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Is she not mad anymore？)
Hey, we made plans for a date, right？
(A call... Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Is she not mad anymore？)
Let's call it off after all？ Sorry.
(A call... Oh, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Is she not mad anymore？)
Hey. About our next date plans.
No. So let's just cancel the plans.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Hey, can we meet up now？
Not yet. I don't want to see you.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Hey, can we meet up now？
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Hey, can we meet up now？
I don't want to see you.
So that's the kind of thing you work hard at.
I wish you'd pay proper attention to me too...
Because I can't help being curious.
I wasn't watching to blame you.
I know. You tried hard for me.
I'm sorry, I've reflected. I never knew not talking with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ would hurt this much.
That's not it... I was so scared about what I'd do if you came to hate me...
I'm sorry... I never want that again...
Yes. I saw you trying hard.
I'm sorry too. But I don't want you to do that again...
Yeah. I don't want ▲高嶺＊＊▲ to hate me anymore.
No, even when you're mean to me, I keep loving you more... and that scares me...
Do you get it？ I wasn't being mean because I wanted to...
I know, it was my fault. Sorry.
I thought you'd come to hate me... I was scared...
I'm really sorry. For hurting you.
I was scared... I was lonely！
Huh!? Wait a sec... Okay, come in.
Was it okay for me to visit？
Yes, I feel a little better. Thank you. Sorry you came all this way.
Of course I would. I worry about my girlfriend.
▲高嶺＊＊▲ always works too hard. You need to relax more.
If I stay too long, it'll wear you out. I'll head home.
Of course. See you, take care.
...Huh. Um, wait a sec... Come in.
I came to visit. How are you？
Thank you. Yes, I feel much better.
I was just getting bored. I was wishing I could see you.
Me too. If I couldn't see ▲高嶺＊＊▲ any longer, I'd get sick too.
If I stay too long, it'll wear you out. I'll head home.
Getting better is more important. I'll come again. See you.
Here I am, the one you've been waiting for, right？ Just kidding.
Huh, you're more honest than usual.
Haha, right. If you're happy, it was worth coming.
I always kind of dreamed of this. When you get sick, your boyfriend comes to visit.
For the visitor, it'd be better not to have to come at all, though.
If I stay too long, it'll wear you out. I'll head home.
Yeah, I'll come again. See you.
I'm happy, but... if you keep coming, you'll catch it, you know？
If that'd cure you, maybe that's not so bad.
No！ I want to go out with you as soon as I'm better. So you can't get sick！
Okay, okay. I get it, calm down.
When you visit like this, it's like I have you all to myself. It's kind of nice.
Right？ So, being healthy is better after all.
I'm happy you came, but won't you catch it？
Then want to try something that'd make me catch it？
Hehe, I thought about it for a second.
Yes, I'm fine. Thanks to your visits, maybe.
I hope so. Maybe it was bad for you, though.
Not at all. I'm a doctor's daughter, so trust me on that.
Let's go out a lot again, okay？
I'm all better. Thanks for visiting.
You're welcome. Don't push yourself again, okay？
Okay. But going out with you is fine, right？
Then good. I'm counting on you？
As you can see. Thanks to my boyfriend's visits.
Hehe, let's go on a date soon. I've been holding back.
(Bored... I'm sick of being stuck at home.)
Sorry you came all this way.
Not at all. I thought you might be bored.
Oh, I'll be a bother if I stay long. I'll go home now.
Not at all... but okay, thanks for today.
If you need anything, let me know？ Like, help around the house.
I can't ask that much. I'm fine, thanks.
(I need to get better fast, for ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s sake too.)
(Bored... I'm sick of being stuck at home.)
I came to visit. If it's not a bother.
Not a bother. I wanted someone to talk to.
Yeah, seeing ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s face made me feel better right away.
Oh, talking too much isn't good for you.
Is the housework okay？ Want me to help with anything？
It's fine, it's fine. I'm managing.
......Then, I'll go home today. If anything comes up, let me know？
(I need to get better fast, for ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s sake too.)
(Bored... I'm sick of being stuck at home.)
Sorry I'm late. I came to visit.
Yep, I waited and waited. I'm worn out from waiting.
Geez, if you're that lively, maybe I didn't need to come？
Oh, we talked so long. You need to rest. I'll go home soon.
I'm a doctor's daughter, you know？ Push yourself too hard and I'll give you an examination.
N-Nothing. See you, thanks for today！
(I need to get better fast, for ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s sake too.)
It's hard to say in words... Hey, can't you tell？
My lips are lonely. A kiss would cure me.
...Not yet. I'll think about it when you're better.
Hehe, very good. Get well soon, okay？
Yeah, I can't kiss you until I'm better...
Sorry to keep you waiting. Thank you for your visit.
Yeah. Now if I go out with ▲高嶺＊＊▲, it'll be perfect.
Sorry to keep you waiting. Thank you for your visit.
Yes... I'm glad. Don't get sick again...
Yeah. Sorry for making you lonely. Let's make up for it by being together.
Sorry to keep you waiting. Thank you for your visit.
I'm glad... Oh, no more getting sick and worrying your girlfriend, okay？
Let's go out lots. Then I'll forgive you.
